title: The Chamber
author: Dell Harrow, crew chief
pages: Deep in the hull there's a chamber we can't cut. Round, the size of a truck cab, and it beats. You can feel it through your boots.
Teo put his ear to it and wouldn't come away for ten minutes. I'm calling it the Heart, because I don't know what else to call it. Told the crew nobody cuts into it. Teo didn't answer me.
